cases.estimand: Component-wise ordered scanpath similarity after monotone alignment, optionally within a time window.
conventions: eyesim exposes a sixth order-insensitive EMD component
cases.independent_case: Three-point paths on a 100 by 50 screen distinguish direction, length, position and duration normalization.
cases.planned_evidence: Pinned eyesim fixture reconciled separately from the existing Python implementation conformance.
cases.divergence: Five components match exported R on non-square translated, duration/geometry changed, straight, stationary and tied self paths at 1e-12. Baseline wrapper keeps six named slots and requires three fixations; sixth EMD remains explicit unavailable consistent with no-exact-solver decision. Legacy five-component MultiMatch two-fixation support remains. Native checked admission and empty/window/component errors replace R shape-changing missing outputs. Python evidence remains separately identified. Measured sixth backend values are not exact-EMD oracles.

cases.estimand: Order-insensitive fixation-pattern transport or proportion of sampled trajectory positions within a spatial threshold.
conventions: direct fixation_overlap defaults to threshold 60 and 20-unit times; similarity.fixation_group defaults to threshold 40 and requires time_samples
overlap uses strict distance < threshold and all requested times in its denominator
fixation Sinkhorn uses normalized x/y/onset and duration weights, returning 1/(1+cost); distinguish it from a raw cost or debiased divergence
cases.independent_case: The selected paths cross the distance threshold between query times and distinguish interpolation from fixation-only matching.
cases.planned_evidence: Reference outputs for both overlap metrics and a dependency-locked Sinkhorn case.
cases.divergence: Explicit queries, strict threshold, Euclidean/Manhattan distances and all-requested denominator agree; native complete-support policy and located failures are separate. Native scaled position/onset duration-weighted log-domain entropic transport uses p=2 squared cost, root cost and 1/(1+rootCost), not debiased divergence or a metric. Independent primal and analytic oracles qualify converged native results. Default T4transport lambda=.01 fails frozen 1e-7 comparison gate (delta 1.78e-6, marginal residual 8.94e-6); retained default/extended plans document stopping divergence. Native nonconvergence/overflow/matrix size/identity failures are explicit.
